summary: Gramicidin is a polypeptide antibiotic active against Gram-positive bacteria. It is too toxic for systemic use (haemolysis) and is used only topically, mainly in neomycin-polymyxin-gramicidin eye and ear drops.
indications: Superficial eye and ear infections (in combination drops)
admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Forms ion channels in bacterial membranes.
preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: Martindale: The Complete Drug Reference (Pharmaceutical Press)
footer: StewardMD-authored DRAFT. No US, Canadian or EU regulatory label exists for this molecule; AI-drafted from the references above and awaiting clinician review. Doses are typical published ranges, not a product label: check the Indian product's own pack insert before prescribing.
